opportunities.title: Operating/Core Cost Grants

amount.raw: Unlikely to fund more than 10% of an organisation's total annual budget

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, Charitable Incorporated Organisations (CIOs), or exempt/excepted organisations under Charity Commission guidelines; at least one year's worth of annual accounts (independently audited or examined, or Charity Commission annual return); work delivered within the UK or UK Overseas Territories; cannot fund endowments, building reserves or paying off loans.
opportunities.summary: Grants towards the general costs of running an organisation, including bills, rent and overall salary bill (not specific posts). Cannot be used for endowments, building reserves or paying off loans. Applications accepted on a rolling basis via the Foundation's online grants portal.

opportunities.title: Project/Specific Activity Grants

amount.raw: Grants tend to be 10-20% of a total project cost

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, CIOs, or exempt/excepted organisations; at least one year's worth of annual accounts; work within UK or UKOTs. Foundation unlikely to be the sole funder of a project; recommend around half the project's funding secured before applying.
opportunities.summary: Grants for a specific project or area of work with a defined scope and timescale. Applications accepted on a rolling basis via the Foundation's online grants portal.

opportunities.title: Capital Project Grants

amount.raw: Normally no more than 10% of total project cost; local community projects (e.g. village halls, community centres, places of worship) unlikely to be over £30,000 regardless of project size

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, CIOs, or exempt/excepted organisations; at least one year's worth of annual accounts; work within UK or UKOTs. Relevant planning permissions/faculty permissions should be secured before applying; at least 20 years on lease if building not owned; recommend around half of total project costs raised before applying.
opportunities.summary: Grants for building works, repairs or equipment necessary to an organisation's work. Applications accepted on a rolling basis via the Foundation's online grants portal.

opportunities.title: Major Grants

amount.raw: Grants of £100,000 and over; total cost of what is being applied for must be at least £1 million

opportunities.eligibility_summary: For core costs, organisation's annual income must be £1 million or over; for capital/project costs, the total cost of the project must be at least £1 million. Must pass the Foundation's eligibility quiz (UK registered charity, CIO, or exempt/excepted organisation; at least one year's accounts; work within UK/UKOTs).
opportunities.summary: Major grants of £100,000 or more for organisations whose project or income is at least £1 million. Applicants complete a Major Grant Expression of Interest Form, after which the Foundation provides bespoke guidance within 10 working days. Applications accepted on a rolling basis.
